title: Summed oracle cost bound
statement: Let $a,t$ be natural numbers, and let $cost$ and $charge$ be functions from the natural numbers to the natural numbers. If $cost(r)\le a(r+1)+a\,charge(r)$ for every $r<t$, then $a+\sum_{r=0}^{t-1}cost(r)\le a(t+1)^2+a\sum_{r=0}^{t-1}charge(r)$.
hypotheses_covered: functions cost and charge from naturals to naturals
for every natural r<t, cost(r) ≤ a(r+1)+a·charge(r)
